title: Bad Apple on an E-ink E paper display (2022)
summary: A demo of the Bad Apple music video played back at 60 FPS on an e-ink display, up from 2.4 FPS in an earlier attempt. It is part of the effort behind the open source Modos e-ink monitor.
why: HN cites it as the demonstration that e-ink can do low-latency, video-rate refresh with an open hardware controller.

quote.text: a fully open hardware controller that can run at 60FPS[1] with 1bit BW
